title: Bitumen felt roof over 25 years old

mitigation.action: Roofer inspects the felt, the seams and the penetrations and replaces the covering when it has cracked

known_quirks: Felt cracks at the seams and around chimney and vent penetrations first
Low-pitch felt roofs pond water and leak into the attic insulation without visible marks inside
Check gutters and roof safety products every spring and autumn (Kunnon Koti to-do)
why_hint: DRAFT: The roof is bitumen felt and over 25 years old. Felt reaches the end of its service life at 20 to 30 years and leaks first at the seams.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: A roof check or a new covering keeps rain out of the attic insulation and the ceiling structure.
